name: Fingal
intro: Fingal is the quiet southern crook of the Peninsula that, almost without anyone noticing, became Australia's hot-springs capital. There is barely a village here  -  a country lane lined with horse paddocks, a cluster of cellar doors and lavender farms, and then, set back from the road, two of the country's most ambitious thermal-bathing destinations within ten minutes of each other. Peninsula Hot Springs opened the field in 2005; Alba Thermal Springs answered it in 2023 with a Scandinavian-architectural language. Beyond the steam, Fingal is back-beach country  -  Bushrangers Bay, Cape Schanck and the start of the Two Bays Walk are all within fifteen minutes. People come here to soak, then drive five minutes for a long lunch, then soak again at dusk. The rest of the Peninsula doesn't really know what to make of it, which is fine, because Fingal already knows what it is.
factualLede: Fingal is a small rural locality on the Mornington Peninsula's southern back-beach belt, 95 km from Melbourne, home to Peninsula Hot Springs, Alba Thermal Springs and the back-beach gateway to Cape Schanck.

heroImage.alt: Steam rising from the geothermal bathing pools at Peninsula Hot Springs in Fingal

tldr: Fingal is Australia's hot-springs capital — Peninsula Hot Springs and Alba Thermal Springs sit five minutes apart on a quiet country road.
Best for: bathers and wellness weekenders; couples wanting a slow, low-key base; walkers using Cape Schanck and Bushrangers Bay.
Signature experience: a hilltop soak at Peninsula Hot Springs at first light, breakfast, then a back-beach walk before the day warms.
Two nights is the right rhythm — one day at each springs, with a walk and a long lunch in between.
There is no village centre — choose your base for the soak, not the streetscape.
notFor: anyone wanting a town to wander
signature: Two of Australia's most ambitious bathhouses, ten minutes apart, on a country road most visitors miss.
skip: Trying to do both springs on the same day — you will overcook yourself and not enjoy either.
bestDay: Dawn soak at Peninsula Hot Springs, breakfast at the bathhouse, mid-morning walk to Bushrangers Bay, lunch at Polperro or Montalto, late-afternoon Bath House session at Alba, dinner held loosely.
insiderNote: Book Peninsula Hot Springs for dawn and Alba for dusk on separate days — the light at both is the actual headline.
